title: Planes and Parasites
description: Escape the surface and take to the skies in a Create-powered survival experience where sprawling airships become your home, factory, and last refuge from the unstoppable fungal horrors below.
body:
The world below is lost.

A relentless fungal infection has consumed the surface, twisting landscapes into hostile wastelands and transforming anything left behind into something far worse. Survival now belongs to those willing to abandon the ground entirely and carve out a new life among the clouds. Using the engineering power of Create and its many addons, you’ll design, expand, and maintain fully functional airships that serve as mobile bases, factories, farms, and sanctuaries high above the spreading infestation.

This modpack blends industrial creativity with atmospheric survival. Build intricate mechanical systems to automate production, manage fuel and resources, and keep your airborne home running smoothly while drifting over a dying world. Cozy quality-of-life mods make life aboard your vessel feel lived-in and personal, turning cramped machinery decks into warm workshops, kitchens, gardens, and crew quarters.

But safety in the skies is never guaranteed. Supplies on the surface are limited, and dangerous expeditions into infected territory are often necessary to recover rare materials, ancient technology, or forgotten loot. Every descent becomes a risk-reward decision: stay safe above the clouds, or brave the fungal nightmare below for the resources needed to keep flying.

Whether you become a wandering scavenger, an industrial sky captain, or the commander of a massive flying fortress, the skies are now humanity’s final frontier.
